root_cause.text: Reinitializing the shared waitqueue head via `dvb_ringbuffer_init()` on every DVR device reopen orphans existing waitqueue entries from concurrent poll/epoll operations, leading to corrupted list pointers and potential use-after-free.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states: "dvb_ringbuffer_init() calls init_waitqueue_head(), which reinitializes the waitqueue list head to empty. Since dmxdev->dvr_buffer.queue is a shared waitqueue (all opens of the same DVR device share it), this orphans any existing waitqueue entries from io_uring poll or epoll, leaving them with stale prev/next pointers while the list head is reset to {self, self}." The patch replaces `dvb_ringbuffer_init()` with direct assignment of `data` and `size` plus `dvb_ringbuffer_reset()`, which does not touch the waitqueue or spinlock.
